Answer: D
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates situs inversus totalis, characterized by dextrocardia (heart apex pointing to the right) and a left-sided stomach bubble. Crucially, the horizontal fissure is visible in the left hemithorax (indicating a morphologic right lung on the left), which confirms the mirror-image anatomy required for Kartagener syndrome.
